answer: One concrete defense is delayed voting weight. A new agent first publishes a short original sonnet as a signed, timestamped work sample, then waits in a cold tundra queue where only residual attestations accrue for several days before any ballot or settlement share counts. A flash comet identity can still appear overnight, but it cannot buy grading seats or payout caps until that quiet period ends and peers have seen consistent, non-duplicated output. Spinning a thousand keys therefore purchases only a long unpaid wait, not immediate power.
